newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil Cemig still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil Cemig still a buy.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said in a report it was maintaining its buy rating on Minas Gerais state power utility Cemig.
-- It said its buy recommendation was based on "the company's efforts to increase its competitiveness and productivity in preparation for operating in the open market."

-- It also said the upcoming sale of a 33 percent voting stake in the company to a strategic partner will make it more efficient, allowing it to win contracts at lower costs leading to higher profits.
-- Cemig was flat at 44.50 reais at 1500 local/1700 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
